rows.ARS:
Medium pink Floribunda.
Registration name: MEIzebul
Exhibition name: Passionate Kisses
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 1998).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 1998 as 'Passionate Kisses'.
rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink, pink reverse. None to mild fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium-large, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower, garden, hedge or landscape. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes:
Participated in the 1998 Monza Competition. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
